subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do we approve these fourteen third-party action releases, including `openai/codex-action`, after the exact Codex contract and final-head behavior of the credential-bearing workflows are reviewed?
rationale: The patch changes executable third-party code at secret- and token-bearing CI boundaries; repository policy requires direct Codex-source inspection, and the available PR evidence does not prove the refreshed workflows behave safely.

options.title: Refresh, inspect, and validate before approval
options.body: Rebase to current main, review the exact Codex action/runtime contract, and attach redacted trusted-run evidence for the affected privileged workflows before merging.

options.title: Split the Codex action update
options.body: Land only independently approved non-Codex action pins and keep the Codex action upgrade in a separately reviewed security-boundary change.

options.title: Pause the grouped upgrade
options.body: Hold this Dependabot PR until a workflow-security owner can review all revised action SHAs together.

recommendation.title: Refresh, inspect, and validate before approval
recommendation.body: Rebase to current main, review the exact Codex action/runtime contract, and attach redacted trusted-run evidence for the affected privileged workflows before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: It is the only concrete security-routing owner signal in the supplied item context; a human workflow-security owner should be selected during manual review.
